entities.summary: Naghsh-e-Jahan Stadium, is a football stadium in Isfahan, Iran. It has been the home stadium of Sepahan between its completion in 2003 and 2007, and again since its reopening in 2016. With a current seating capacity of 75,000 it is the second largest stadium in Iran.
